newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's plans restaurants in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's plans restaurants in Pakistan.

text.p: McDonald's Corp said Tuesday it expects by the end of 1998 to open restaurants in Karachi and Lahore, Pakistan, a new market for the company.

"We believe Pakistan will be a dynamic market for McDonald's," said Jim Cantalupo, president of McDonald's International. "Of the international markets we have yet to enter, Pakistan is by far the largest and offers us significant untapped potential."
There are over 140 million people in Pakistan.

McDonald's said it expects a significant portion of the supplies it requires for its restaurants in Pakistan to be sourced within Pakistan. While the menu for its Pakistani restaurants has not been decided, it is expected to be the traditional array of products offered in other markets. However, all beef and chicken products will be prepared according to Muslim custom.
McDonald's currently operates in more than 100 countries.
